title: The CYBER-BRIDGE project: An AI-Powered Platform for Cross-Border Cybersecurity, Compliance and Forensics in the EU
abstract: arXiv:2611.21497v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-border cyber attacks on European SMEs and critical-infrastructure operators expose a structural cyber-resilience gap: cybersecurity (threat sharing, detection, response), compliance (framework assessment, certification) and digital forensics (cross-jurisdictional evidence) are jointly regulated by NIS2, the CRA, GDPR and the LED, yet their tooling evolved in silos and rarely interoperates across Member States. The EU-funded CYBER-BRIDGE project integrates the three domains under one architecture and a hash-chained evidence layer: AI-driven CTI sharing with ENISA-aligned notification, multi-framework assessments with retrieval-augmented advisory, and RFC 3161-anchored custody with lawful GDPR/LED exchange, all aligned with MITRE ATT&CK. translated_title: CYBER-BRIDGE项目：欧盟跨境网络安全、合规与取证的人工智能驱动平台
translated_abstract: 针对欧洲中小企业和关键基础设施运营商的跨境网络攻击暴露出一个结构性的网络韧性差距：网络安全（威胁共享、检测、响应）、合规（框架评估、认证）与数字取证（跨司法辖区证据）共同受NIS2、CRA、GDPR和LED四项法规约束，但相关工具各自在孤立领域中演进，很少能在欧盟成员国之间实现互操作。由欧盟资助的CYBER-BRIDGE项目将这三大领域整合于统一架构和哈希链证据层之下：包括符合ENISA标准的AI驱动网络威胁情报（CTI）共享与通知、结合检索增强咨询的多框架合规评估，以及基于RFC 3161时间戳锚定的证据监管链与符合GDPR/LED要求的合法数据交换，全部与MITRE ATT&CK框架保持对齐。此外，后端系统的净化副本托管了一个用于人员技能提升的网络靶场。该项目的贡献不在于单个工具本身，而在于其协调机制——使单一安全事件能够（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CYBER-BRIDGE项目的核心贡献在于提出了一个协调机制，将网络安全、合规与数字取证三大领域整合于统一架构和哈希链证据层之下，使单一安全事件能够同时生成符合NIS2、CRA、GDPR和LED多项法规要求的跨境响应输出。
en_tdlr: The key contribution of the CYBER-BRIDGE project is a reconciliation mechanism that unifies cybersecurity, compliance, and digital forensics under one architecture with a hash-chained evidence layer, enabling a single incident to produce outputs compliant with NIS2, CRA, GDPR, and LED across EU borders.
